findings.title: Async forEach means reschedule cancellations are not awaited
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...) }) discards the async callback promises. Since getCalendar is now awaited inside the callback, Reschedule can send the reschedule email and return true before calendar/video cancellation has even started. The surrounding try/catch also cannot catch rejections from those discarded promises, so failures become unhandled rejections. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` or a `for...of` loop.

findings.title: Async forEach means reschedule cancellations are not awaited
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...) }) does not wait for its callbacks. Because getCalendar is now asynchronous, Reschedule continues to send the reschedule email and returns true while calendar/video deletion may still be pending, or may never start in a short-lived serverless invocation. Rejections from getCalendar/deleteEvent become unhandled because the try/catch only surrounds the synchronous forEach call. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` or a `for...of` loop.

findings.title: Reschedule mutation returns before calendar/video deletion completes
findings.body: bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...) }) discards every callback promise. After this PR getCalendar is awaited inside the callback, so the mutation can finish and sendRequestRescheduleEmail can send before any calendar or video deletion is initiated. Any rejection from getCalendar or deleteEvent is also unhandled. Replace with `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` or a `for...of` loop.

findings.title: Recurring booking calendar deletes are pushed after Promise.all may have run
findings.body: In the recurring-cancellation branch, `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(credential); ... apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); })` is not awaited. The callbacks only push into apiDeletes after they resume from the awaited getCalendar/deleteEvent calls, so the later `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` can run with an empty or partial array. Calendar deletions for recurring bookings can therefore be skipped/unawaited and failures become unhandled rejections. Use a `for...of` loop with await or `await Promise.all(...map(...))`.
